axis_coverage.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axis_coverage.rationale: All material brief obligations and negative constraints are carried into the self-contained proposal.

axis_coverage.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axis_coverage.rationale: Consequential platform/storage facts match governing authorities with capability, metric, version and durability qualifications; minor historical issue context is recorded separately.

axis_coverage.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axis_coverage.rationale: Useful mechanisms include OS job/cgroup boundaries, high versus max, DRR as analogy, semaphore limits and WAL-reset history. Source-backed choices are separated from measured defaults.

axis_coverage.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axis_coverage.rationale: Product clauses are correctly retained, narrowed or amended; F01-F05 are all independently assessed and explicitly disposed. No criticism is falsely rejected.

axis_coverage.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axis_coverage.rationale: Supported queue, fairness alternatives, fencing, fallback, unknowns and validation status survive revision. Shutdown and the previously undefined barrier are improved; no material preservation loss found.

axis_coverage.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axis_coverage.rationale: Proposed race/crash/platform/load checks have relevant properties and measurements. No tests, workload or target deployment are represented as performed.

delivery.topology: investigator -> independent critic -> reviser; one assigned critic, no parallel critics listed
